Data.title: AppLinkAppServiceEventData Event Data
Data.description: The data within all AppLinkAppServiceEventData events.

type.description: The type of the entity generating the event: user for user-initiated transitions, system for platform-confirmed transitions

id.description: The unique identifier of the user generating the event. Omitted when type is system

Auth.title: Auth
Auth.description: Auth information of the generated event

href.description: Link to the resource that has generated the event

uuid.description: Equinix assigned unique identifier of the resource generating the event. For attachment events, the UUID of the attached Application Domain, Service, or Processor

type.description: Type of the resource generating the event: APP_LINK, APP_DOMAIN, APP_SERVICE, APP_SUBSCRIPTION, or APP_PROCESSOR

attachmentStatus.description: Attachment status of the Application Domain, Service, or Processor on the Application Link. Set only for attachment events

geoScope.description: Geographic scope of the Application Service attachment. Set only for Application Service attachment events

destinationIp.description: Destination IP address of the Application Service attachment. Set only for Application Service attachment events

Resource.description: Schema of the resource that fired the event
